unmatched_predictions.title: Async/Await inside Array.forEach does not await promises
unmatched_predictions.description: Using `async/await` inside a standard `Array.prototype.forEach` callback does not pause execution of the loop or outer function. The promises returned by `getCalendar` or `deleteMeeting` will be unawaited, leading to unhandled promise execution order or background execution without error handling.
unmatched_predictions.suggested_fix: Replace `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async ...)` with a `for...of` loop: `for (const bookingRef of bookingRefsFiltered) { ... }`
